name: Karl Marc
bio:
Renowned for his mastery in black and gray tattoo artistry, Karl Marc is an exceptionally skilled tattooist whose intricate designs leave clients both impressed and delighted. Operating out of HANDMADE FINE TATTOO at 70 rue du Vertbois in Paris, France, Karl combines precision and artful creativity in every piece he inks, establishing himself as a respected figure in the tattoo community. His professionalism is evident not just in the stunning results of his work but also in the meticulous care he takes with each and every client.
